r1.desc: R1 pre-E6 measurements on one PRO 6000: (b) E5 matrix on N fixed-seed prompts sized from a cost model: target alone, draft-simple K=4 (control), K=4 with target backend sampling (-bs), K=2/3, K=4 with the post-hoc PTQ1_0 draft, ngram-mod / ngram-map-k on the code categories (per-category r, alpha, tok/s, speedup with bootstrap CI, output equality); (a) Qwen3.5-0.8B BF16/Q8_0/post-hoc PTQ1_0 top-1 agreement and KL vs Bonsai 2 27B PQ2_0 (llama-perplexity, 8192 tokens, E5 chat text built from part b outputs); (c) one nsys capture of ~20 K=4 steps split by stream role into verify, draft re-eval, draft steps, copies and idle; needs --allow-long (est 43 = downloads ~6 + r1 37; with clone and cold CUDA build ~14 the pod runs ~58 of the 65 failsafe)
